verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for a cloud compute platform like Modal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents token scoping, per-agent credentials, or permission-limited API keys. Environments (an `--env` flag) and Workspace budgets are adjacent controls, not scoped credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
